Synthetic résumés (invented people) printed by headless Chromium from HTML
templates in the layouts people use, as originals for the layout-profile and
export tests:

- `nurse-serif-letter-2p.pdf`: Times 11.5pt, 1in margins, ragged, US Letter,
  two pages, a "Certifications" section and a name with credentials.
- `accountant-a4-ragged.pdf`: Arial 10pt, A4, 0.6in margins, ragged,
  left-aligned header, no heading rules.
- `marketing-dense-unicode.pdf`: Helvetica 8pt, 0.32in margins, one page,
  a Polish name, "→" and a Vietnamese company name.
